headline: LONDON FASHION WEEK 2026 🌆 Drops FIVE 🍒 Trends For SPRING 🌷
text:
LONDON 🏙️ FASHION 👗 WEEK 🕒 is CLOSING 🏁 its CURTAINS 🎭 after a week of PURE 🧪 CREATIVE 🍆 CLIMAXES 😩 as ALEXANDER 👑 MCQUEEN finally came 🏠 HOME after TWENTY 🕒 FIVE years 🌟 away from the catwalk 🚶‍♀️!! The historic RETURN 🚪 fused SEVERE 🪓 TAILORING with dark 😈 ROMANTICISM ❤️‍🔥 leaving everyone at the British Fashion Council dripping 💧 with excitement 🌹!! CEO Laura Weir told the BBC it was a "quite a big deal" for London while creative director Seán McGirr brought back DEVIL 🦇 HORNS 🦌 lace CORSETS 🧶 and CHAINMAIL 💀 SKULL dresses that had the whole runway throbbing 💓!! This season was all about RETURN 🛬 and RENEWAL 🌱 with MULBERRY 🍇 also sliding back after nine years of being away making everyone edge 😣 closer to that fashion climax together!!

REJECTING 🚫 that BORING 😴 quiet luxury uniform the messy girl aesthetic took OVER 💥 at Chopova Lowena Sinead Gorey and Conner Ives with deliberate CHAOS 🌀 undone tailoring and messy updos that looked like they just got railed by a tornado 🌪️!! Elektra Kotsoni the deputy director for Vogue Business straight up declared "The number one trend for this season is messy girl" promising us a full on messy girl summer while calling it a REACTION 🧪 to those clean girl feeds that had us all down bad last year!! She told the BBC the world is quite messy so this dressing screams RESILIENCE 💪 and rebellion mixing pastel colors 🌈 dreamy florals 🌺 and tactile materials into unexpected CLASHES 🥊 that look really messy on purpose!! This crazy styling was LOUD 📢 at those shows turning the runway into a hot rebellious orgy of deliberate dishevelment that left the audience absolutely spent 🥱!!

GARDENCORE 🌱 is now OFFICIALLY 🍑 COOL according to Kotsoni with Erdem Yuhan Wang and Bora Aksu trading quiet luxury for unpolished allotment ready CHAOS 🧑‍🌾 that pairs parkas and structured trench coats with kitchen garden details like you just finished plowing the back forty 🌿!! It's a fresh twist on cottagecore ditching the gingham and wicker for looks that scream fresh from planting seeds or riding that lawnmower 🍑!! There are loads of gardening appropriate silhouettes like aprons 👩‍🌾 waterproof materials and trench coats that started after Loewe dropped that watering can shaped handbag a couple months back!! Kotsoni says fashion is always a reflection of what's happening in the world and she loves how these designers took gardening and made it TANGIBLE 👐 on the runway turning soil play into pure fashion foreplay that has us all ready to get our hands dirty!!

MODERN 🏛️ GODDESS vibes are SLAYING with organic draping trailing ribbons and delicately hitched slip skirts inspired by Ancient Greece and that Christopher Nolan Odyssey film that has everyone feeling breezy and bohemian 🌬️!! Pauline Dujancourt's show was the EPITOME 💋 of this style going all in on maximum volume and billowing fabrics that looked like they could float away after a long night of mythical edging!! Kotsoni pointed out these looks are in total opposition to how guests showed up dressed super minimalist in that quiet luxury way suggesting people are TIRED 😩 of it and ready for the turning of the tide!! Her team predicts draped garments breezy materials and flowy silhouettes will dominate making everyone feel like a free spirited goddess getting railed by the wind itself!!

ORANGE 🍊 is the BIG 🍑 COLOUR trend for next year whether you prefer melon tangerine ginger or coral as Mulberry Justin Cassin Enny Atelier and Vin plus Omi all drenched their shows in it over the last few days!! Kotsoni is hedging her bets that some shade of orange might snatch Pantone's color of the year for 2027 especially after it invaded celebrity styling like Kylie Jenner and Timothée Chalamet's matching neon outfits at that Marty Supreme premiere!! The vibrant hue kept popping up on runways and presentations making everyone thirsty for that juicy citrus energy that screams summer seduction!! It's the perfect rebellious pop against all the minimalism leaving the fashion world pulsing with fresh juicy heat!!

BALLET 🩰 is very much IN FASHION now even after Timothée Chalamet said "no one cares" about it back in May which Kotsoni finds interesting as it's now forged into a clear trend for next year!! Edeline Lee transformed a school sports hall into a full ballet stage for her latest collection drawing from the intense discipline repetition and physical toll of classical dance that left models en pointe and the audience gasping!! Ballet flats are massive and small silhouettes for shoes will dominate next season so hit up those charity and vintage shops if you wanna replicate the look!! Vogue Italia dropped La Scala principal dancer Roberto Bolle on the cover while Royal Ballet's Francesca Hayward is modeling for Armani and Chanel proving ballet is the ultimate fashion muse getting us all stretched and spent in the best way!!
